bettergregtechponder.ponder.chemical_rea: The panel is the machine's own UI, without the player inventory.
64 grass blocks into slot 1 and 64 glass into slot 2; the panel shows the machine's real contents.
Fluids work the same way: tank 0 fills from 0 to 1000 mB within one second.
Covers can target a side too: a conveyor on the top face.
The model can be switched between working and idle on its own: only the front overlay changes, the recipe logic stays untouched.

One recipe id is all it takes: the panel feeds the inputs, sets the circuit to the tier the recipe asks for, and while the progress bar runs the machine is working; the product comes out when it finishes.
Auto-output sides are machine state as well: items leave through the west face, fluids through the south face.
showFullUI() draws GT's whole UI, and the switches in that configurator column can be boxed one by one: working toggle, auto-output and circuit settings.
